svg.title: Rakuten.ca and Scene+ grocery-adjacent stack
svg.desc: Bars comparing an in-store Empire till, a Voila click through Rakuten with Scene+ conversion, and a gift-card shop purchase.
svg.text: Portals pay on clicks, not on a FreshCo aisle
Illustrative $100 eligible spend. Scene+ converts Rakuten Cash Back at 100 points per $1, paid quarterly. Rates move.

g.text: Shelf price wins; points are a rebate
~1% CB - still a click fee if you add delivery
Grocery gift card in Gift Card Shop
~2% if listed; till bonus often excluded

svg.text: Screenshot the merchant tile before you click. Gift cards and unlisted promo codes can void Cash Back. Saving Optimizer - 20 Sep 2026.
